repository.description: Manage members, visibility, and deletion for {name}.
repository.notFound: Repository not found or you do not have access.
repository.forbidden: Only repository admins can manage settings for {name}.

image.subtitle: Image settings in {repository}
image.notFound: Repository not found or you do not have access.
image.forbidden: You do not have permission to manage settings for {name}.

visibility.title: Default anonymous pull
visibility.description: Applies to all images unless overridden on an individual image settings page.
visibility.label: Allow anonymous pull
visibility.fieldDescription: When enabled, unauthenticated clients can pull images that inherit this repository default.

members.title: Members
members.description: Add existing users to this repository and assign roles. New users must be created in Admin first.

pendingAlert.title: Pending invites need attention
pendingAlert.description: This invite stays pending until the user signs in with a verified email address. If they logged in via OIDC without email_verified, a system admin must link or remove the invite manually.

members.searchMinLength: Type at least 2 characters to search.
members.createUserHint: Create the user in <adminLink>Admin → Users</adminLink> first, then add them here.
members.createUserHintNoAccess: Ask a system admin to create the user in Admin → Users first.
members.selectUserRequired: Select a user from the search results.

machineAccounts.title: Machine accounts
machineAccounts.description: Credentials for CI pipelines to pull or push this repository's images with docker login, without a personal login.

empty.title: No machine accounts yet
empty.description: Create one to let a CI pipeline log in to this repository.

createDialog.title: Create machine account
createDialog.description: The secret is shown once after creation.
createDialog.name: Name
createDialog.nameHint: Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, 2 to 63 characters, starting with a letter.

errors.nameInvalid: Use 2 to 63 lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, starting with a letter.
errors.nameTaken: This name is already used by another machine account in this repository.

createdDialog.title: Machine account created
createdDialog.description: Use the secret below to log in as {name}.
createdDialog.warningTitle: You won't see this secret again
createdDialog.warningDescription: Copy it now and store it in your CI secret store. If you lose it, rotate the secret to get a new one.
createdDialog.commandHint: The username {username} is informational; the secret alone identifies the account.
createdDialog.copyFailedDescription: Select the text and copy it manually.

deleteDialog.title: Delete machine account {name}?
deleteDialog.description: Anything logging in as {username} stops working immediately. This cannot be undone.

expiry.label: Expiration
expiry.invalid: Choose an expiration date within the limit set by your administrator.
expiry.maxValidityHint: Your administrator limits the validity to {days} days.

rotateDialog.title: Rotate secret of {name}
rotateDialog.warning: The current secret stops working immediately. Update every pipeline or host that uses it.
rotateDialog.expiredHint: This account has expired. Set a new expiration to rotate it.
rotateDialog.doneDescription: Use the new secret below to log in as {name}.

editDialog.title: Edit {name}
editDialog.description: The name, permissions and secret stay the same.

disableDialog.title: Disable machine account {name}?
disableDialog.description: Logins as {username} fail until you enable it again. Registry tokens already issued stay valid until they expire.

rolesMatrix.title: Role permissions
rolesMatrix.description: What each repository role can do in this registry.
rolesMatrix.systemAdminNote: System administrators can perform any action regardless of repository role.

repositoryDanger.title: Danger zone
repositoryDanger.description: Permanently delete this repository and its metadata.

dialog.title: Delete {name}?
dialog.conflict: This repository still has images: {images}. Enable force delete to remove them first.
dialog.blocked: Deletion is blocked while non-empty images remain unless you force-delete.
dialog.forceDescription: Force delete removes every image and manifest in this repository before deleting the repository record.

imageSettings.title: Anonymous pull
imageSettings.description: Override the repository default for this image. Members with access can always pull when authenticated.

inherit.label: Inherit repository default
inherit.description: Use the repository-wide anonymous pull setting.

allow.label: Allow anonymous pull
allow.description: Unauthenticated clients can pull this image.

deny.label: Deny anonymous pull
deny.description: Require authentication even when the repository is public.

imageDanger.title: Danger zone
imageDanger.description: Permanently delete this image and all of its tags from the registry.

toast.successDescription: Removed {count, plural, one {# tag} other {# tags}}.
